verdict.rationale: Docs confirm notebooks can be made public and shared via a link with anyone with a Google account, with usage analytics for paid public notebooks, and notes can be exported to Google Docs/Sheets for further collaboration. However, there's no evidence of granular collaborator roles (view vs edit), real-time co-editing, or comment/collaboration features beyond public link sharing, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of the sharing experience. Missing for 10: evidence of role-based permissions or collaborative editing, and independent corroboration of the sharing workflow.
